narrative.overview: A transit map, not a dashboard. Warm map paper, dark station signs for sections, a drawn line with numbered stops, a district diagram. One teal line and one coral local stop; everything else is ink, rules and plain type. Dark mode is the night palette.
keyCharacteristics: Flat and ruled: heavy ink rules, 2 to 3px frames, ruled tables; no decorative shadows.
Station signs head sections; stop numbers and a drawn line connect them.
Teal is the line and main action; coral is the local stop and the one key call to action.
Public Sans for everything; Overpass Mono only for ledger figures.
Every state visible: hover, pressed, busy, unavailable, focus (3px ring).
44px tap targets and 16px fields on phones; dark mode mirrors every token.
Not yet tried with a screen reader or on a real phone.

rules.name: The One Local Stop Rule
rules.body: Coral marks the local stop and the single call to action that matters most on a screen. If a screen has two coral things, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Line Is Not A Boundary Rule
rules.body: `line` is decoration. A control's border uses `edge`, so it meets 3:1.

rules.name: The Pairs Are Tested Rule
rules.body: Any new text/background pair is added to `ColorContrast::PAIRS` and passes in light and dark before it ships.

rules.name: The Plain Figures Rule
rules.body: Money is set with `tabular` (tabular, lining figures) so columns align and zeros read as zeros.

rules.name: The Phone Is The Card Rule
rules.body: Design the 320px phone first; desktop is the same page given room.

rules.name: The Honesty Line Rule
rules.body: Demo, projection and "not measured" labels never sit in anything hidden on phones.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Public Sans plus Overpass Mono for figures. No third face; hierarchy from size, weight and caps.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: No decorative shadow, glow or blur. Shadows only draw parts: ink rings, halos, focus.

dos: Do head sections with a station sign and inner pages with .page-head, .page-title, .page-lede.
Do keep teal as the line and main action, coral once per screen.
Do put control borders on `edge` (#7d7564) and decoration on `line` (#c8bfa8).
Do use ruled tables via <x-rtable>, plus <x-breakable> and <x-eyebrow>.
Do show every state; keep 44px targets and 16px fields on phones.
Do add any new color pair to ColorContrast::PAIRS and keep the two dark blocks in app.css identical.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, blur, emoji or decorative shadows.
Don't add a font, or bring back Overpass or Atkinson for text, or forest, cream, paper, amber, sage or the awning.
Don't use a second coral call to action or pills for anything big.
Don't stack cards in cards or box a table.
Don't put the merchant line on a candidate.
Don't use break-all or hide honesty lines on phones.
Don't convey status by color alone, and never remove, merge, hide or rename content or navigation in a design pass.
